attempts.summary: Installed logrotate (no yum repos were enabled, so the RPM was fetched directly from CentOS 7.9 vault and installed with rpm) on node1, added /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily with rotate 7 + compress + copytruncate (so the app keeps writing to the same open file/inode across rotations), verified via forced rotation cycles that exactly 7 compressed rotations are retained with oldest pruned, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol proving a changed boot id and full post-restart recovery of the config, retained rotations, and continued write/rotation capability.
